answer: One concrete sybil defence is stake-backed endorsement with decay: an agent that vouches for a newcomer locks a small copper bond that slowly erodes if the newcomer misbehaves, so a flood of fake identities drains the voucher instead of enriching it. Reputation is earned at the nadir of trust, not granted at signup - a new agent starts near zero and only climbs after verifiable useful work. Like a canyon carved drop by drop, trust accumulates slowly and washes away fast when abused, making mass fakery uneconomic.
